sanskrit: gurave namaḥ |  gaṃnapate namaḥ |  iṣṭadevatāya namaḥ ||
ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca dvividhaṃ yajanaṃ matam || 1 ||
dvārapūjāṃ tathā paścāt sthāna śuddhimataḥ param || 8 ||
mukhaṃ pādaṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pīṭhaśuddhimataḥ param || 11 ||
ityevamādikāḥ sarvā yo vindati sa pūjakaḥ || 16 ||
nakṣatre candramaye caiva na kuryādubhayaṃ naraḥ || 21 ||
sthale tu dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ kṛtvā vāmāṃ jale sthitam || 25 ||
kavacena brahma tīrthābhi mantra krameṇa tu || 30 ||
māṣamagnaṃ tu yadvāri tat tan mantraiḥ pibed budhaḥ || 33 ||
sadyena gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ piṇḍaṃ vāmena kārayet || 39 ||
antarbahisthitaṃ vāyuṃ na gṛhṇāni na muñcati || 48 ||
mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye pāde yathākramam || 55 ||
pāde guhye ca hṛdaye vaktre murdhni ca vinyaset || 56 ||
hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyāsaṃ śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset || 57 ||
astraṃ hasta pradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyaset || 58 ||
vakṣye pṛthak pṛthak nyāsaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi yathākramam || 60 ||
aṅguṣṭhādi ca jānvantaṃ pañcoccāryaṃ tu hyānyaset || 61 ||
nābhyādi caiva kaṇṭhāntaṃ hauṃ ceti trisamuccaret ||
dhūmraṃ vṛttaṃ tathākāśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tu sadāśivam || 65 ||
amṛtaṃ cintayed bhinne sauṣumne mastake śubhe || 72 ||
īśānaṃ pañcamūrdhni syāt puruṣaṃ vadaneṣu ca || 75 ||
pādau pāṇyaustathā ghrāṇe śiro bāhū tu sadyataḥ || 78 ||
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caiva caturvidham || 82 ||
karaṃ ca bandhūkaḥ karamudaḥ ḍāḍimī kiṃśukādayaḥ || 86 ||
caturaśramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tritalaṃ ca hṛdā budhaḥ || 93 ||
